C1.worst_defect: The first screen says what it is, who it is for and what to click, but never what it costs: nothing near the hero says the hosted till at app.vendurepos.com is free to use, which is the first question a buyer comparing against Shopify POS or Square asks.
C1.where: home/desktop/01 (hero and 'Your own store needs the plugin…' line)

C2.worst_defect: The default path runs your till from app.vendurepos.com, yet the site never says who operates it, whether it stays free or what happens if it goes away; the only exit, self-hosting, needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' with no price or link, so 'MIT licensed' quietly depends on a paid third-party licence, and the analytics host ph.wcpos.com hints at a parent (WCPOS) the site never names.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Before you start › Setting up the store'; connect-a-till/desktop/01 'Where requests go'

C3.worst_defect: The device-key path ships with a known permission bug the reader must patch by hand: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself', six weeks after the last plugin release (0.3.0, 2026-10-06) with no fixed release named.
C3.where: quick-start text 'Optional: a device key for each till'; connect-a-till 'Create and use a device key'

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for the authors, not users: entries such as 'GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)' and 'order.create v5 custom lines … created per channel at bootstrap' cite internal ADRs and protocol versions, and a 'Not in the release notes:' aside about the missing ReadOrder is buried at the end of a long 0.2.0 bullet.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' opens with two boxed proof cards, then switches to eight unboxed heading-and-paragraph items in a plain grid, so the feature section changes style halfway; otherwise clean, and dark mode holds up.

C6.worst_defect: On the phone header only 'Docs' and 'Live demo' show; 'Quick start' and 'At the till' sit behind an unlabeled chevron, and long code lines such as the generateMigration call wrap mid-argument, which makes them hard to read.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse flags largest-contentful-paint at 2.6 s on /docs/quick-start (score 0.88) plus about 150 ms of render-blocking requests on /; the 404 status, llms.txt, sitemap, search API and share card are all sound.

overall_worst.defect: A consultant cannot tell a client who stands behind VendurePOS: the till they would run every sale through is hosted at app.vendurepos.com by an unnamed operator with no terms, the self-host fallback needs a paid RxDB Premium licence with no price, and the only clue to the maintainer is the unexplained ph.wcpos.com analytics domain.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 'Before you start'; connect-a-till/desktop/01 'Where requests go'
overall_worst.fix: Add two sentences to 'Before you start': who maintains VendurePOS and runs app.vendurepos.com (and its relation to WCPOS/TallyUI), that the hosted till is free with no uptime promise, and a link to RxDB Premium's price for self-hosting.
